verdict.rationale: Publishing a robots.txt is a fair question for any public web service. The only direct evidence is a probe showing robots.txt returns 404 on the tax.delaware.gov portal host, and nothing in the pack shows a robots.txt on revenue.delaware.gov. Calling revenue.delaware.gov 'the open crawled surface' does not show that a robots.txt file is published there.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
